symptom: BRAIN delivery PR #746 failed closed with unclassified delivery path for legitimate tests/chat-learning-* and tests/make-agent-learning-* governance tests even though their dedicated and shared CI tests were green.
rootCause: The delivery lane taxonomy used explicit path prefixes and did not yet include the two legitimate learning-contract test families.
failedApproaches: Treat the red delivery gate as CI noise because the unit tests were green.
Rename legitimate tests cosmetically merely to match an existing prefix.
Broaden the classifier so far that unknown test families no longer fail closed.
Patch a stale BG168 branch directly after main changed the same delivery-control-plane config.
preventionRules: Every new executable or governance test family must be classified in the canonical delivery taxonomy before its owning PR can be considered delivery-green.
Unknown active paths remain fail-closed; add the narrowest semantic prefix rather than a wildcard that hides future ownership gaps.
A green unit or feature workflow never overrides a red BRAIN delivery-plan gate.
When main changes the same delivery-control-plane config, rebuild from current main and preserve concurrent classifications instead of forcing or overwriting.
Use a dedicated regression workflow when feature-specific coverage can avoid mutating a shared CI hotspot.
